{{Top|leg}}
A '''Mission Function Module''' was a self-contained unit intended for use with the [[modular taskforce cruiser]]. Once hooked into the [[Starship/Legends|starship's]] skeleton, it was connected to the [[Power generator/Legends|power generators]], [[Life support/Legends|life support]], and communications systems. At least five Modules were produced; the [[hospital module]], the [[survey module]], the [[observation module]], the [[rescue module]], and the [[inquisition module]].
